proposals.evidence: DEDR 2484 explicitly lists Tamil cāṟu “juice, pepper water”, Malayalam cāṟu “broth, soup”, Kannada sāṟu “sauce, pepper water”, and Merolu cāru “a kind of curry”. Muduga cāṟɯ has the same liquid-food sense; the article family applies despite its displayed reconstruction “to go reach”.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 3111 lists Tamil/Malayalam taviṭu and Kannada/Telugu tavuḍu “bran”, matching Muduga tavuḍɯ in consonants and sense. The paper gives this form as a vowel-conditioning example without proposing a different origin.
